Q: How are taxes applied to an order?
A: Taxes are applied automatically from the restaurant's configured rates: 5 percent on most food items and 18 percent on packaged goods in this demo configuration. [1] The point of sale terminal is where staff ring up orders at the counter. [1] The brief shows its working - every figure links to the orders behind it. [2] When the guests place the order, it lands on the kitchen display as an online order and is attached to the table's tab. [3] That is a deliberate choice: a manager can check a number against the underlying orders and trace exactly how it was computed. [2] Everyone who scans the same table code sees the same cart, which is how a group coordinates one order. [3]
